verdict_reason: Multi-tenant scoping is sound — organisationId is on the entity, leads the only compound index and is enforced on every service/repository read and write path — but the entity carries no @Version, leaving the update/delete read-modify-write open to lost updates and tombstone resurrection.

todos.issue: Address has no @Version field, so the read-modify-write in OperatorService.update()/delete() is last-write-wins: repository.save() replaces the whole document, so a PUT that loaded an ACTIVE address and saves after a concurrent DELETE writes status=ACTIVE back and resurrects the tombstone (and two concurrent PUTs silently lose one edit).
todos.fix: Add '@Version private Long version;' alongside the audit fields, add matching @Mapping(target="version", ignore=true) / ignoreUnmappedSourceProperties entries in OperatorMapper (unmappedTargetPolicy and unmappedSourcePolicy are both ERROR), and map OptimisticLockingFailureException to a 409 problem in GlobalExceptionHandler.
